listing.name: Tekken Tag Tournament 2 (tekken-tag-tournament-2-pc)
listing.summary: Upstream route: ttt2_setup.exe is bootstrapper/installer: checks own disc+TU3, builds PCversion and prepares shaders. Separate ttt2-server packages are hosting utilities. Upstream installer/server maintainers own runtime preparation; Portcove does not. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream advertises 59 fighters, rollback and ranked play. Installer/TU3 preparation and dedicated-server coverage remain distinct; gameplay untested here. Player installer ttt2_setup.exe differs from server Linux/ARM64 packages. Do not label dedicated server assets as Linux player runtime. Upstream 59-fighter/rollback/ranked claims untested here. Upstream platforms: Windows 10/11 player installer. Windows/Linux amd64 and Linux ARM64 server packages are not Linux player runtimes. Original data: Xbox 360 Tekken Tag Tournament 2 own game and supported title update. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
